title: First Registrars Wins the CFI.co Award for Best Share Registrar, Nigeria
author: CFI.co Editorial
content_html:
The CFI.co Judging Panel has named First Registrars Nigeria Limited, one of 25 registration companies in the country, as winner of the 2014 award for ‘Best Share Registrar, Nigeria.’

According to the panel, ‘First Registrars certainly has the edge with its highly experienced team and very strong products and services. Customer care at First is exemplary. Formerly a wholly owned subsidiary of First Bank of Nigeria Plc, good corporate governance is a key focus of operations here and our winner offers an outstanding share/bond register administration service. First is indeed a very worthy winner of this award’.
